p: old age: Therefore the miracle was greater.
Who would have said unto Abraham: She accuses herself of ingratitude, that she did not believe the angel.
mocking: He derided God's promise made to Isaac which the apostle calls persecution Ga 4:29.
called: The promised seed will be from Isaac, and not from Ishmael, Ro 9:7, He 11:18.
a nation: The Ishmaelites will come from him.
sent her away: True faith renounces all natural affections to obey God's commandment.
heard the voice of the lad: For his promise sake made to Abraham; and not because the child had discretion and judgment to pray.
opened her eyes: Unless God opens our eyes, we can neither see, nor use the means which are before us.
with the lad: Concerning outward things God caused him to prosper.
swear: So that it is a lawful thing to take an oath in matters of importance, to justify the truth, and to assure others of our sincerity.
I wot not who hath done: Wicked servants do many evils unknown to their masters.
covenant at Beersheba: Thus we see that the godly, concerning outward things may make peace with the wicked that do not know the true God.
called there on the name of: That is, he worshipped God in all points of true religion.
